Remembering Dontre Hamilton, a man whose life was cut short by gunfire in a Milwaukee Park. @Erik__Ljung made a documentary about it. Here's the trailer for "Blood is at the Doorstep." https://t.co/SiM3tGxiko
#DontreHamilton #SayHisName #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/TEXCbgygWX
6 years ago today Alexia Christian died of gunfire. #SayHerName #AlexiaChristian #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/k8DV84WODJ

In 2003 Kendra James became a #gunfire death statistic. But she was more than that. She was the mother of two boys who are now young men. Children she never got to see grow up. #BlackLivesMatter  #SayHerName #KendraJames https://t.co/Ix2JDgehJJ

Today we remember Dreasjon "Sean" Reed... son, brother, colleague, friend, shot to death one year ago today in Indianapolis. #SayHisName #DreasjonReed #SeanReed #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/aYRfsY6Jyl

Keaton Otis was shot to death while having a mental health crisis. Activists look to his case as reason for police reform. His parents would love to have their son back. #BlackLivesMatter #SayHisName #KeatonOtis #MentalHealth https://t.co/D62WzDcvB8
